import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import re
from collections import defaultdict

NS = {
    "m": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/main",
    "r": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships",
}

def col_to_idx(ref):
    m = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)(\d+)", ref)
    letters, num = m.group(1), int(m.group(2))
    idx = 0
    for ch in letters:
        idx = idx * 26 + (ord(ch) - ord("A") + 1)
    return idx, num

with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    print("FILES IN ARCHIVE:")
    for n in names:
        print(" ", n)
    print()

    # workbook.xml -> sheet names and relationships
    wb_xml = z.read("xl/workbook.xml").decode("utf-8")
    wb_root = ET.fromstring(wb_xml)
    rels_xml = z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels").decode("utf-8")
    rels_root = ET.fromstring(rels_xml)

    rel_map = {}
    for rel in rels_root:
        rel_map[rel.get("Id")] = rel.get("Target")

    sheets = []
    for sh in wb_root.find("m:sheets", NS):
        rid = sh.get("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id")
        sheets.append((sh.get("name"), rid))
    print("SHEETS:", sheets)
    print()

    for name, rid in sheets:
        target = rel_map[rid]
        if not target.startswith("/"):
            target = "xl/" + target
        print(f"=== Sheet: {name} (target {target}) ===")
        try:
            sheet_xml = z.read(target).decode("utf-8")
        except KeyError:
            sheet_xml = z.read("xl/" + target).decode("utf-8")
        root = ET.fromstring(sheet_xml)

        # shared strings
        strings = []
        if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in names:
            ss_root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml").decode("utf-8"))
            for si in ss_root.findall("m:si", NS):
                text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/main}t"))
                strings.append(text)

        # styles: number formats (to identify dates/currency) -- keep simple: just show value
        rows = defaultdict(dict)
        for c in root.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/main}c"):
            ref = c.get("r")
            if not ref:
                continue
            ci, ri = col_to_idx(ref)
            v = c.find("m:v", NS)
            t = c.get("t")
            if v is None:
                value = ""
            elif t == "s":
                value = strings[int(v.text)]
            elif t == "inlineStr":
                is_el = c.find("m:is", NS)
                value = "".join(x.text or "" for x in is_el.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/main}t"))
            elif t == "b":
                value = v.text == "1"
            else:
                value = v.text
            rows[ri][ci] = value

        for ri in sorted(rows):
            cells = rows[ri]
            line = " | ".join(f"{chr(64+c) if c<=26 else c}:{cells[c]}" for c in sorted(cells))
            print(f"row {ri}: {line}")
        print()

import zipfile

with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    print("--- xl/workbook.xml ---")
    print(z.read("xl/workbook.xml").decode("utf-8"))

    print("--- xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels ---")

    print("--- xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml (first 3000 chars) ---")
    print(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml").decode("utf-8")[:3000])

import zipfile

with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    xml = z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml").decode("utf-8")
    print(xml[3000:])
